newsitem.title: USA: UroCor sees lower than expected Q2 shr.
newsitem.headline: UroCor sees lower than expected Q2 shr.

text.p: UroCor Inc said Wednesday it expected second-quarter earnings to be below expectations at about $0.06 a share, compared to $0.05 for the same period last year.
The company, which offers services to detect, diagnose and manage diseases like prostate cancer, also said it foresaw revenues at $7.7 million against $6.4 million a year ago.
"These results are expected to be significantly below the company's historical growth trends," it said in a statement.
First Call's consensus among industry analysts had forecast earnings of $0.10 for the quarter.

Although the company's core diagnostics service business grew and contributed to an estimated 20-percent increase in expected revenue for the period, it did not meet management's expectations, it said.
UroCor said an expansion of its client base and other factors strained its operations and resources, resulting in lower revenues.
It also said a delay in getting approval from the Food and Drug Administration for PACIS BCG, an immunotherapy for bladder cancer, caused a product gap that it could not fill.
The company said it was hiring more people and investing in its operations to improve its performance.
